name: GDLM 44 hellgate
idea: the first 10 s of song 343707 (the song of the user's favourite level Ragnarok): the hit at 1.72 s (make.js beat b5) opens hell; a new idea every bar, modes switching on bar starts
story: v1 (one jump per 2 beats, flat ground) was 'very bland, old style, no variety, all same height, very weak' (the user). v2: climb pillars -> orb ladder on the hit -> ship through a toothed tunnel -> wave zigzag -> cube drops down pillars -> red pad, single, last gate on the final beat
note: beats are make.js's: b1 = the first beat (0.066 s). Written by hand; compose.js does not place by beats or use modes yet
